title: The test-author merge route opens for any conflict path the builder is refused, mutation tests included
why: Coordinator 15:51 CST Nov 9: `merge_route_paths` in hooks/guard.py opens the test-author merge route only when a conflict is `is_test_rel`, but builder-test-edit also counts the mutation tests (`AUTHOR_MUTATION_TESTS`, such as hooks/mutate_guard.py) as test paths. So a merge whose conflicts are hooks/guard_merge.py and hooks/mutate_guard.py has no role that can commit it. Harm: lane merge-repo-dir-flag is blocked on #2504, and #2106 behind it.
note: Fix: open the route when any conflict is a path the builder is refused, through one shared predicate (rule building-allow-list-is-the-constant). Done check: a test-author merge with conflicts {guard_merge.py, mutate_guard.py} is allowed; one with no author path is still refused. Related: merge-conflict-mixed-roles, mixed-merge-no-role.
